claim_challenged: The helper named se_gene_expr_for_condition implements an IID standard error, and its error invalidates published interaction labels.

adjudication.reason: The inspected notebook derives the labels from an empirical null of observed additive residuals rather than this SE helper. This diagnostic does not invalidate the paper conclusions.

limits: Numerical four-value check is a mathematical reproduction of the actual source formula, not a biological experiment.
IID cell assumptions are not guaranteed biological-replicate independence.
